name: Water — Distilled
use_case: Faraday waves, singing bowl surface, Cymascope

behavior.faraday_threshold: Vertical forcing amplitude above threshold (depends on depth and frequency) causes subharmonic standing waves on the surface.
behavior.dispersion_relation: ω² = (gk + σk³/ρ) · tanh(kd) where k=wavenumber, d=depth, σ=surface tension
behavior.hexagonal_mode_condition: Occurs at specific (depth/wavelength) ratios, typically d/λ ≈ 0.3-0.5
behavior.cymascope_note: Add a drop of dish soap to reduce surface tension and reveal finer detail; adds 2D Marangoni flow that can alter pattern symmetry

notes: Temperature matters: at 20°C vs 10°C surface tension changes ~4%, shifting hexagonal instability threshold by ~8 Hz.
